sections.section_name: Section A - Objective Type / MCQs / True-False

questions.question_text: In an electronic spreadsheet, which symbol is used to lock a row or column to create an absolute cell reference?
What is the primary purpose of utilizing a Slide Master in a digital presentation?
options: A) To control the global layout, font styles, and backgrounds of all slides
B) To compress the file size of the presentation
C) To convert the presentation into a video format
D) To spell-check the entire document at once
questions.answer: A) To control the global layout, font styles, and backgrounds of all slides

questions.question_text: Which of the following is considered a highly effective practice for cyber safety and network security?
options: A) Using the same password across all platforms
B) Disabling the computer's firewall for faster internet
C) Enabling two-factor authentication (2FA) on all accounts
D) Clicking on pop-up ads to claim free prizes
questions.answer: C) Enabling two-factor authentication (2FA) on all accounts

questions.question_text: In a spreadsheet application, what does the formula '=COUNT(A1:A10)' accomplish?
options: A) It adds the total value of all cells in the range.
B) It counts the number of cells containing numerical data in the range.
C) It finds the largest number in the range.
D) It counts the number of empty cells in the range.
questions.answer: B) It counts the number of cells containing numerical data in the range.

questions.question_text: True or False: Custom animation applies movement to individual elements like text boxes and images within a single slide, whereas transitions apply to the whole slide.
Which specific type of malware secretly records your keyboard inputs in order to steal passwords and sensitive information?
What feature in an electronic spreadsheet is used to display only the rows that meet a specific user-defined condition or criteria?
When delivering a presentation, which keyboard shortcut key traditionally starts the slideshow from the very first slide?
Which cyber threat involves overwhelming a web server with a flood of fake internet traffic so it becomes unavailable to legitimate users?
options: A) DDoS (Distributed Denial of Service) Attack
questions.answer: A) DDoS (Distributed Denial of Service) Attack

questions.question_text: In presentation software, what exactly is a 'slide transition'?
options: A) The method of inserting a new blank slide
B) The visual effect that occurs when moving from one slide to the next
C) The timing set for a video to play
D) The hyperlink connecting two different presentations
questions.answer: B) The visual effect that occurs when moving from one slide to the next

questions.question_text: Explain the mechanical difference between an Absolute Cell Reference and a Relative Cell Reference when copying formulas down a column. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Relative references change automatically based on the relative position of rows and columns. Absolute references stay locked to a specific cell address using dollar signs when copied.

questions.question_text: Describe the main time-saving advantage of using a Slide Master in presentation software. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The Slide Master ensures visual consistency across the entire presentation. By changing fonts, logos, or backgrounds on the master, all connected slides update automatically, saving significant time.

questions.question_text: Define the term 'firewall' in the context of computer network security. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: A firewall is a network security system that monitors and controls incoming and outgoing traffic based on predetermined security rules, acting as a barrier against untrusted networks.

questions.question_text: What is the specific purpose of conditional formatting in an electronic spreadsheet? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Conditional formatting automatically applies visual styles, like colors or bold text, to specific cells only when their data meets user-defined criteria, making data analysis much easier.

questions.question_text: Identify the core security difference between HTTP and HTTPS when browsing the internet. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: HTTPS includes an encryption layer using SSL/TLS protocols, ensuring that the data transmitted between the user's browser and the website server remains secure and hidden from attackers.

questions.question_text: Explain how to use the IF function in a spreadsheet to determine if a student has 'Passed' or 'Failed' based on their score in cell C2 being greater than 40. [30-40 words]
questions.answer: Select the target cell and enter the formula =IF(C2>40, "Passed", "Failed"). This logical function evaluates if the score in C2 exceeds 40; if true, it displays "Passed", and if false, it outputs "Failed" automatically.

questions.question_text: Differentiate between slide transitions and custom animations in a digital presentation workflow. [30-40 words]
questions.answer: Slide transitions are the visual effects applied to the entire slide when moving from one slide to the next. Custom animations are applied to individual elements within a slide, like making bullet points or images appear sequentially.

questions.question_text: A student downloads a 'free' version of a paid software. Suddenly, their computer locks, and a message demands payment in cryptocurrency to unlock the files. Identify this cyber threat and outline three preventative measures to avoid it. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: This attack is known as ransomware, a malware that encrypts user data for extortion. To prevent it, users should never download pirated or unverified software, maintain regular offline backups of important files, and ensure active, updated antivirus software is running to detect and block malicious executable files instantly.

questions.question_text: Describe the complete step-by-step procedure for creating a column chart from spreadsheet data and embedding it into a presentation so it updates dynamically. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: First, highlight the data range in the spreadsheet and insert a column chart. Copy the created chart. Open the presentation slide, go to 'Paste Special', and select 'Paste Link'. This creates a dynamic OLE connection, ensuring that any future data changes in the spreadsheet automatically update the presentation chart.
